design_notes: Each title-absent product has vehicle data in merchant fields (tech_specs or variant description) but NO vehicle in Catalog title
Matched controls: title-present products from the same store, same vehicle, different category where necessary
Category matching is imperfect — MAP has no title-present brake pad products (all use 'Multiple Fitments' pattern)
Pre-registered decision rule: H4 supported if title-absent presence@50 >= 0.40 below title-present; rejected if within 0.15; inconclusive if between or <6 matched pairs
Deviation from pre-registration: matched pairs are not same-category for MAP controls (no same-category title-present products exist)
